name: moneyminder
description: Phone-first budgeting app: scan receipts, track spending against a budget, and split shared costs with roommates.

scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['package.json','package-lock.json','public/manifest.webmanifest','extension/manifest.json'])JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));console.log('JSON manifests valid');"
scripts.check:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),cp=require('node:child_process');const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.js')||e.name.endsWith('.mjs'))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});}};for(const d of ['server','public','extension','test','scripts'])walk(d);"
scripts.verify: npm run check:json && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:coverage
